_readme: Copy to streamers.json. Keys are the streamer's Twitch login. The autopilot only clips streamers with a 'permission' note (who agreed, when, on what terms) and a 'channel' (a name you connected with: python autopilot.py connect <channel>). Links are credited in every description; only add channels you have checked are theirs. Optional: 'source' (a VOD list URL for non-Twitch streamers), 'game' (when the VOD does not say), 'tags', 'vertical' (false for 16:9 clips), 'vertical_style' ('blur' or 'crop').
